# Mister KD — Kadir Demir

> “I build what the world snacks on next.” Kadir Demir (Mister KD) is a food & beverage product developer. He develops functional snacks people want to eat again, from formulation to shelf. Co-founder of Muscle Cheff (since 2015) and YOUNITED, founding board member of Smarter Snacks and Bite & More.

## My Creations
- [My Creations](https://misterkd.com/#creations): 45 product creations across YOUNITED (13), Bite & More (19) and Muscle Cheff (13), shown on six shelves in product-number order.
- [Bars & chocolate](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-bars) (6), [Cereal](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-cereal) (3), [Puffs & chips](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-puffs) (11), [Spreads](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-spreads) (6), [Bakery](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-bakery) (11), [Drinks](https://misterkd.com/#aisle-drinks) (8).
- Each product shows its number, brand, name and the claim on its pack. Pack imagery is shown as part of Kadir's product portfolio; claims reflect the relevant product or formulation.

## About Kadir
- [Who stocked this shelf](https://misterkd.com/#about): a snack has to taste good enough to buy again, be practical to make, be priced for its market and be ready for retail. Kadir's career began in finance, audit and business development; he brings that commercial discipline to food: ingredients, texture, nutrition and production cost, then consumer feedback and shelf performance.
- 100+ countries of inspiration: flavour, food habits and retail insight. This is inspiration, not a distribution footprint.

## Brands
- [YOUNITED](https://misterkd.com/#brands), currently building: co-founder, product design & development. Protein candy bars, cereal cups, real-cheese puffs and spreads, a gourmet snacking range made in the EU. Candy bars: 15 g protein, ≤199 kcal and 0 g added sugar per bar. Site: https://younitedsnacks.com/
- Smarter Snacks: founding board member. High-protein snacks developed around flavour and texture; product innovation, market expansion and retail partnerships.
- Bite & More: founding board member. Protein pancakes and waffles, vegan puffs and iced protein coffee.
- Muscle Cheff: co-founder since 2015. Protein chocolate, spreads, chips, cookies and drinks.

## Bench to shelf
- [The process](https://misterkd.com/#process): 1,000+ product trials. Ingredient testing, nutrition balancing, texture engineering, global benchmarking, consumer feedback and retail performance.

## Work with Kadir
- [Four ways to work with me](https://misterkd.com/#work): partnerships & co-creation (a snack or product line from concept to launch); product & innovation consulting (formulation, nutrition, texture, manufacturing partners and production costs); retail & distribution (market entry, distributor strategy and retail expansion); speaking (functional food, product development and building snack brands).
- [Your project brief](https://misterkd.com/#contact): online sending is not switched on yet. Visitors can download their brief as a text file; nothing is sent from the page.

## Related
- [YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking](https://younitedsnacks.com/): the snack brand Kadir co-founded and is currently building.

Product names and nutrition statements reflect the pack or formulation shown. This is Kadir's product portfolio, not an online shop.
